title: Nourishing Brazilian Cream Wrap
description: A comforting Brazilian dish featuring a creamy, briny filling wrapped in a ti-leaf wrap. Perfect for a cozy meal or snack.

ingredients.name: Rendered fat (such as coconut oil or avocado oil)
Canned black beans, drained and rinsed

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of rendered fat in a pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped red onion and cook for 2-3 minutes, until softened.
Add the diced tomatoes and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the canned black beans, dried mint leaves, salt, and black pepper.
Cook for 1-2 minutes, until the flavors are combined.
Stir in the squeezed lime juice and cook for an additional 30 seconds.
Warm the ti-leaf wraps according to package instructions.
Spoon the black bean mixture onto the center of each wrap, followed by sliced avocado.
Fold the bottom edge of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the wrap to form a tight cylinder.
